visualCharacteristics: Plain indented body-size text, no quotation marks, no portrait or attribution.
contentPattern: Indented quotation within article body (e.g. from the Melbourne Declaration). Row 1 quotation text; optional row 2 attribution.
usage: Inline quotation inside article copy, rendered as an indented paragraph.
reuseGuidance: Use for quoted passages from documents or declarations within body text. Not for testimonials with portraits.
